description: A ferry port's live departures and arrivals for today: scheduled, estimated and actual times, vessel and status (on time, departed, cancelled with the reason). About 25 ports have a board (小琉球, 東港, 綠島, 富岡, 南竿, 金門水頭, ...); use ferry_timetable for the others. Example: port "小琉球".

limit.description: Maximum number of sailings to return (default 40).

port.description: The port: name (綠島, 富岡, 小琉球, 基隆, 南竿) or port ID (TWGNI).

name: ferry_live_board
title: Ferry port live board
